name: navbar-onepage
title: One-page navbar
description: A navbar for single-page sites: section links that scroll to their section, the current one marked, and one call to action.
docs: Give sections as an id and a label each, in the order they appear; every link is a real fragment link, so it works before script loads. Give each section scroll-mt-20 (as tall as offset, 80px by default) so a visitor who arrives with the hash in the address also clears the bar. The section in view is marked with aria-current="location" as you scroll; pass currentId to mark one yourself. A click scrolls smoothly (instantly under reduced motion), moves focus to the section's heading and calls onNavigate. On a phone the links are in a sheet that closes itself before the scroll. The mark links to brandHref ("#top" scrolls to the top and drops the hash of the section you were in); a call to action with href="#contact" scrolls like the rest. onNavigate is a function, so use the bar from a Client Component.
